719-864-7507-8043.easyPrerequisites: You haven't cast a spell for free using Vision this turn.
719-864-7507-8043.description:
Cast Kindred Charge for free due to Vision, choosing a creature type granted by Xenograft, creating a token copy of each creature you control with haste, and setting up a delayed exile trigger.
Put the copy of Vision whose ability has been used in your graveyard due to the legend rule.
When the Eternal Witness token enters, it triggers, returning Kindred Charge from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

529-1879-5641-8181.description:
Activate a creature by tapping it, causing you to surveil 1.
Denzilore triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control.
Basking Broodscale triggers, creating a creature token.
Repeat.

requires.n: One-drop creature with a second body

1957-4050-6094--204.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the one-drop creature, adding {B}.
When that creature dies, it and Vengeful Bloodwitch trigger.
Resolve the creature's ability, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Vengeful Bloodwitch ability, gaining at least one life and causing at least one opponent to lose at least one life.
When you gain life, Veinwitch Coven triggers, causing you to pay {B} to return the one-drop creature from your graveyard to your hand.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the token creature, adding one colored mana.
Cast the creature by paying one mana.
Repeat.

2366-4875-6879-8095.easyPrerequisites:
You are able to play a land this turn.
"[Type]" chosen with Conspiracy.
2366-4875-6879-8095.description:
Play Dryad Arbor.
When Dryad Arbor enters as an Ally due to Conspiracy, Haru triggers, earthbending Dryad Arbor.
Activate Dryad Arbor by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate Hammerhead by sacrificing Dryad Arbor.
When Dryad Abor dies, Haru triggers, returning Dryad Arbor from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Dryad Arbor enters as an Ally due to Conspiracy, Haru triggers, earthbending Dryad Arbor.
Resolve the Hammerhead ability.
Repeat from step 3.

1839-3629-8089.easyPrerequisites: Cloudsteel Kirin attached to a creature you control.
1839-3629-8089.description:
Activate Kuro by paying life.
Repeat step 1 until you have 0 life.
Cast Mister Negative by paying {5}{W}{B} plus commander tax if applicable.
When Mister Negative enters, it triggers, swapping your life total with an opponent's.
The opponent loses the game due to having 0 life.

1116-2292-2738-4871.description:
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Tenacious Dead.
When Tenacious Dead dies, it, Sek'Kuar, and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Sek'Kuar trigger, creating a creature token.
In response to the remaining trigger, activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability from step 5.
Activate two Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {B}{B}.
Resolve the Tenacious Dead trigger, paying {1}{B} to return it to the battlefield from your graveyard.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability from step 1.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to any other creature you control

676-1251-3259.notablePrerequisites: At least one opponent cannot block creatures you control.
676-1251-3259.description:
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached and Magnus the Red, triggering Breath of Fury and Magnus the Red.
Resolve the Magnus the Red trigger, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Breath of Fury trigger, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to a creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one. 
Repeat each combat phase.

104-475-3263-4186.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
104-475-3263-4186.description:
Gain life in any way.
Cleric Class triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Scurry Oak.
Scurry Oak triggers, creating a creature token that enters the battlefield as an artifact due to Mycosynth Lattice.
Leonin Elder triggers, causing you to gain life.
Repeat from step 2.

789-1263-3967-4871.description:
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing Bloodsoaked Champion.
When Bloodsoaked Champion dies, Pitiless Plunderer and Gutter Grime trigger, creating a creature token and a Treasure token.
Resolve the Yahenni ability.
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Yahenni ability.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}.
Activate Bloodsoaked Champion by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

1368-4885-5477-6321.notablePrerequisites: You have at least three other cards in your graveyard.
1368-4885-5477-6321.description:
Cast Malevolent Rumble for its escape cost by paying {1}{G} and exiling three other cards from your graveyard, causing you to mill at least three cards and create a 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature token.
Activate the Eldrazi Spawn by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate the Eldrazi Spawn by sacrificing it, adding {C}.
Repeat.

608-1636-5516.description:
Activate Red Death by tapping it, adding {R} and goading a creature an opponent controls and causing that opponent to draw a card.
Xyris's first ability triggers, creating a 1/1 Snake creature token.
When the Snake enters, Intruder Alarm triggers, untapping all creatures.
Repeat.

1267-4034-5686.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
1267-4034-5686.description:
Declare Yore-Tiller Nephilim as an attacker.
Yore-Tiller Nephilim triggers, returning Medomai from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped and attacking.
Deal combat damage using Medomai, triggering its ability, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Medomai.
Repeat each turn.

2092-2438-2757-5140.description:
Activate a basic Swamp by tapping it, adding {B}.
Activate Kenrith's fifth ability by paying {B} due to Agatha, returning Carrion Feeder from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Activate Earthcraft by tapping Carrion Feeder, untapping the basic Swamp.
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing it.
Repeat.

328-3260-4078-5686.easyPrerequisites:
Your life total is 10 or greater.
You have at least two opponents, or your devotion to black is at least ten.
328-3260-4078-5686.description:
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Gray Merchant.
Activate Chainer by paying 9 life due to K'rrik, returning Gray Merchant from your graveyard to the battlefield as a Nightmare in addition to its other creature types.
When Gray Merchant enters, it triggers, causing each opponent to lose life equal to your devotion to black and causing you to gain that much life.
Repeat.
328-3260-4078-5686.notes: The additional gained life can be used by Chainer to return all creature cards from all graveyards to the battlefield under your control.

2173-4446-5220-6505.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one Cleric
2173-4446-5220-6505.description:
Activate Spore Frog by sacrificing it.
When Spore Frog dies, Mortuary and Relic Vial trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Spore Frog from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Relic Vial trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Spore Frog ability.
Cast Spore Frog from the top of your library by paying 1 life.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more charge counters on it

1563-3899-4365-4460.description:
Activate Spawning Pit's second ability by paying {1} and removing two charge counters from it, creating two creature tokens
Activate the tokens by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Activate Spawning Pit's first ability twice by sacrificing the tokens, putting two charge counters on Spawning Pit.
Repeat.

2464-3713-5078-6650.easyPrerequisites: The Lunar Whale has attacked this turn.
2464-3713-5078-6650.notablePrerequisites: Song of Freyalise's first or second chapter ability has triggered this turn.
2464-3713-5078-6650.description:
Activate Battered Golem by tapping it, adding {1}.
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {1}.
When Sensei's Divining Top enters, Battered Golem triggers, untapping Battered Golem.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with three or more +1/+1 counters on it

2068-2762-4050-5346.description:
Activate Thopter Squadron's first ability twice by paying {2} and removing two +1/+1 counters from it, creating two 1/1 Thopter artifact creature tokens.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing a Thopter, adding {1},
Crime Novelist triggers, causing you to add {R} and put a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Thopter Squadron's second ability by paying {1} and sacrificing the other Thopter token.
Ashnod and Crime Novelist trigger.
Resolve the Crime Novelist trigger, adding {R} and putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Ashnod trigger, copying Thopter Squadron's ability.
Resolve both Thopter Squadron abilities, putting two +1/+1 counters on it,.
Repeat.

967-2438-3809-6753-7087.description:
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Flameskull.
When Flameskull dies, it triggers, exiling it and the top card of your library with the ability to cast one from exile this turn.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Cast Flameskull from exile by paying {1}{R}{R}.
Prosper's second ability triggers, creating two Treasure tokens.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {2}{R}{R}.
Repeat.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

123-2292-6972.description:
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Highspire Artisan.
When Highspire Artisan dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Highspire Artisan enters, its fabricate ability triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Repeat.

147-413-1269.notablePrerequisites: You have a creature card in your graveyard.
147-413-1269.description:
Cast Exhume by paying its mana cost
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying its mana cost.
When Dualcaster Mage enters, it and Blasting Station triggers, with Dualcaster Mage targeting Exhume.
Resolve the Blasting Station trigger, untapping it.
Holding priority, activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Dualcaster Mage.
Resolve the Dualcaster Mage trigger, copying Exhume
Resolve the Exhume copy, returning Dualcaster Mage from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

1987-2187-3227-4276.notablePrerequisites: Lands you control can tap to produce at least {4}{U}{U}{U}.
1987-2187-3227-4276.description:
Activate any number of lands you control by tapping them, adding at least {4}{U}{U}{U}.
Cast Turnabout by paying {2}{U}{U}, untapping all lands you control.
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {2}{U}, blinking Possessed Skaab and Scrivener.
When Possessed Skaab and Scrivener enter the battlefield, they trigger, returning Turnabout and Ghostly Flicker from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.
1987-2187-3227-4276.notes: If lands you control can tap to produce at least {5}{U}{U}{U}, this combo nets infinite mana. You can then stop casting Turnabout and blink one other permanent using Ghostly Flicker. You may also tap artifacts and/or creatures instead for mana if desired.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to any creature you control

1640-3011-3231.easyPrerequisites: Each opponent's life total is 2 or greater.
1640-3011-3231.description: Activate Heartless Hidetsugu by tapping it, dealing damage to each opponent equal to half their life total, rounded down, times 2, and dealing no damage to you due to Pariah's Shield.
1640-3011-3231.notes: If the opponents have an odd life total, they will have 1 life remaining. If they have an even life total, they will have 0 life and lose the game.

1545-2034-4593-6705.description:
Activate Mite Overseer by paying {3}{W/P}, creating two creature tokens.
When the creature tokens enter the battlefield, Trostani triggers twice, causing you to gain 2 life.
Activate Ashnod's Altar twice by sacrificing the creature tokens, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Repeat.
1545-2034-4593-6705.notes: Once you have infinite mana, you may forego sacrificing the creature tokens

586-2350-5258-5618-6798.description:
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing Priest of Gix.
When Priest of Gix dies, Rakdos triggers.
Holding priority, activate Haunted Crossroads by paying {B}, putting Priest of Gix from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Rakdos trigger, causing you to exile the top three cards of your library with the ability to play them until your next end step.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability from step 1.
Cast Priest of Gix from exile by paying at most {2}.
When Priest of Gix enters the battlefield, it triggers, adding {B}{B}{B}.
Repeat.

1545-2034-3263-4078-4242.notablePrerequisites: Your life total is at least 4.
1545-2034-3263-4078-4242.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Su-Chi, adding {C}{C}.
When Su-Chi dies, it triggers, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Activate Chainer by paying {3} and 3 life, returning Su-Chi to the battlefield from your graveyard.
When Su-Chi enters the battlefield, Trostani triggers, causing you to gain life equal to Su-Chi's toughness.
Repeat.

643-2837-2972.description:
Cast Ganax by paying {4}{R}.
Ganax enters the battlefield, creating either a 2/2 Cat or a 3/1 Dog creature token due to Jinnie Fay.
The Cat or Dog enters the battlefield as a Dragon due to Maskwood Nexus, triggering Ganax, creating either a 2/2 Cat or a 3/1 Dog creature token due to Jinnie Fay.
Repeat step 3.

856-1201-1651-4231.description:
Activate Witch's Oven by tapping it and sacrificing Cauldron Familiar, creating a Clue token, a Food token, and a Treasure token.
Activate Clock of Omens by tapping two artifact tokens, untapping Witch's Oven.
Activate Cauldron Familiar by sacrificing a Food token, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Cauldron Familiar triggers, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and causing you to gain 1 life.
Repeat.

276-2037-3059.notablePrerequisites: Minsc & Boo has at least two loyalty counters on it.
276-2037-3059.description: Activate Minsc & Boo's second loyalty ability by removing two loyalty counters from it, sacrificing Malignus and dealing damage equal to two times Malignus's power to target opponent.

937-3591-4591.description:
During your upkeep, activate Necropotence by paying 1 life, exiling the top card of your library face down.
Repeat step 1 until you have zero life.
Activate Magus of the Mirror by tapping and sacrificing it, exchanging your life total with an opponent.
The opponent loses the game due to having zero life.
